title: Advertisement

questions.question: Do you like advertisements?
questions.sampleAnswer: Honestly, I’m not really into most ads, because I find them repetitive and a bit annoying. I usually skip them quickly, unless they are short and funny.

questions.question: Do you often see advertisements on your phone or computer?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I’d say I see them all the time, because most apps and websites are full of ads. I usually scroll past them quickly, unless one catches my eye.

questions.question: Do you see a lot of advertising on trains or other transport?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I do, quite a lot. There are screens and posters on buses and trains, and I tend to notice them, though I don’t really pay attention unless they’re interesting.

questions.question: Is there an advertisement that made an impression on you when you were a child?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, there is. I can still remember a funny ad about a family and their car that used to play on TV. It was when I was about eight, and I would always stop to watch it because it made me laugh.

questions.question: What kind of advertising do you like?
questions.sampleAnswer: I’d say I quite like creative or humorous ads, because they tell a mini-story and make you smile. For example, funny short ads on social media are the only ones I actually watch to the end.
